name: The Tie-in Nobody Needed

pick.label: Pick a film
pick.heading: Pick a film and give it a collab
lead: Big films don’t just come to the cinema any more. They come to your supermarket, your trainers, your phone case and your breakfast cereal, and half the internet posts about it.
Choose a film and team it up with a brand that has absolutely no business being anywhere near it. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *The stranger the better.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: I am not looking for a marketing plan that would survive a meeting with real people. This is just for a bit of fun. Some collabs make total sense, and some only make sense at two in the morning on TikTok. Both are welcome.

rows: Which film are you teaming up?
A brand, a shop, a food, a Berlin institution… the more surprising the better.
What exactly can people buy, eat, wear or do?
Who buys it first? Fans of the film, people who have never seen it, someone else?
What’s in the first video or picture that makes everyone share it?
A few words for the poster, the packet or the hashtag.

values.product: Swamp Gurken: Spreewald gherkins in a big green jar with a little ogre on the label. The lid makes a loud burping noise when you open it.
values.who: People who were children when the film came out and now buy their own pickles, and anyone who has ever eaten gherkins straight from the jar at midnight.
values.post: Me, on the U-Bahn, trying to open the jar quietly. It is not quiet. The whole carriage turns round.

yours.label: Your collab
yours.heading: Your idea
yours.lead: Fill it in on your own phone or laptop (it stays on your device), and be ready to tell the class about your collab in a few sentences.

rank.label: The ranking
rank.heading: Which collab wins?
rank.lead: Each student tells us about their collab in a few sentences. Add it, then argue it into place until everybody agrees.
